supersedes.correction: a register exists at the doc layer (a 535-line experimentation narrative naming an archived catalog and its reason, a decision log, and 84 T-tag decision IDs); the per-file half of the claim stands

supersedes.claim: ldps_parser_path cites an external path never committed - the third such dangling reference in this program
supersedes.correction: external/ is deliberately gitignored with a written reason (vendored tool with its own repo and a 76M dataset); this is documented exclusion, not drift, and does not belong with the other two cases

kalshi_lane.live_card_status: calibration policy explicitly set to none, with a written precondition (no calibration report history to fit on yet) and a named policy module
kalshi_lane.verdict: DELIBERATE AND DOCUMENTED, incomplete by stated precondition

mlb_lane.alternate_route: Brier IS computed at development time - a walk-forward module uses sklearn brier_score_loss, and two research modules compute model Brier against baseline Brier (a skill score vs the market)
mlb_lane.still_absent: no reliability/calibration curve on the live probability, and no calibration transform applied before position sizing
mlb_lane.verdict: no evidence of evaluation-and-rejection and no evidence of partial wiring; absence of evidence, not evidence of a decision

c2_guards.boundary: guards stop at the eda/atlas discovery layer; selector, modeling, market factory, trends and live cards all run outside them

reimplementation.stated_invariant: the guard module declares itself the ONLY place shuffling is allowed
reimplementation.fairness_note: the four copies use a DIFFERENT scheme (permute the feature within a date block) from the guard (permute the outcome label within a season); defensible for a daily-slate grain, arguably stricter - the cost is four untested implementations and a false invariant, not a wrong method

c2_guards.realised_failure_mode: a documented incident where an input feed was archived and silently stale for roughly three months at 0% coverage before an audit caught and re-wired it

deleted.nature: two terminal/command scratch files and two generated report directories - all in categories the .gitignore already excludes

why_recoverable.per_file: 1 of 26 archived modules carries an archival reason in its header; commit messages touching archive paths are 'updates' and 'system explore'
why_recoverable.per_cluster: recoverable from docs: the experimentation narrative names an archived catalog and the reason it was invalidated, and a doc registry carries supersession status markers
why_recoverable.verdict: preserved at cluster level, lost at file level

cross_cutting_unpersisted_references.ldps_empty_by_design_mechanism: the .gitignore carries a reasoned exception committing forward ledgers as git-timestamped, tamper-evident proof that picks preceded outcomes; zero ledger files are committed
cross_cutting_unpersisted_references.program_wide_pattern: of the four candidate cases, one (ldps external/) is deliberate documented exclusion and does not belong; the remaining three plus the empty ledger share one property - a committed artifact names a path, and nothing checks that the path resolves
